question: What architectures and training recipes reach >=75% CIFAR-100 top-1 (single view, no TTA) in the fewest epochs or least GPU wall time, and how does accuracy scale with epochs and width for ResNet-9/airbench-style networks on CIFAR-100?
must_have: reports CIFAR-100 test accuracy together with epoch count or training time for a fast/short training schedule (<=30 epochs)
exclude: pretrained models, ImageNet transfer, knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher, results only on CIFAR-10

plan.question: Which architectures and training recipes get CIFAR-100 to at least 75% top-1 test accuracy (single view, no test-time augmentation) in the fewest epochs or the least GPU wall time? How does accuracy scale with epoch count and channel width for ResNet-9 and airbench-style networks (patch-whitening stem, label smoothing, Nesterov SGD or Lookahead, short triangular LR schedules) on CIFAR-100? Specifically, is about 8.5 to 10 epochs enough without TTA, and how much accuracy does each extra epoch, or each increase in width, buy near 75%?
queries: fast training CIFAR-100 few epochs ResNet-9 accuracy
airbench CIFAR speedrun patch whitening label smoothing
CIFAR-100 training time budget wall-clock accuracy
budgeted training short schedule CIFAR-100 epochs scaling
width depth epochs tradeoff CIFAR-100 compute-efficient training
rubric: Reports CIFAR-100 top-1 test accuracy together with an epoch count or training wall time for a short schedule (<=30 epochs), trained from scratch
States whether the reported accuracy uses a single view or test-time augmentation, or gives enough detail to tell
Gives an architecture or recipe detail (width, depth, optimizer, LR schedule, label smoothing, augmentation, whitening/init) that could be ported to a ResNet-9/airbench-style network
Preferably reports accuracy at several epoch counts or widths (scaling curves or ablations) so the marginal gain per epoch or per width step near 75% can be estimated
exclude: knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher
accuracies that depend on test-time augmentation with no single-view number
long schedules (>100 epochs) with no short-schedule results
methods that use the test set for training, tuning, or state updates
